title: Stonetalon Mountains
body: The Stonetalon Mountains rise west of the Barrens and south of Ashenvale, forested peaks and deep canyons whose great peak both tauren and night elves hold sacred. In the Third War Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore each came to its caverns seeking the Oracle, and there the prophet Medivh urged orc and human to stand together against the Burning Legion. Now the mountains are wounded: the Venture Company strips Windshear Crag of its forests, the Charred Vale lies in ash, and the spirits of the land cry out in pain.

title: Sun Rock Retreat
body: Sun Rock Retreat is the Horde's stronghold in Stonetalon, a village of tauren and orcs among the peaks. Its leader, the veteran Maggran Earthbinder, was sent by Cairne Bloodhoof himself, to a post where gentle winds and warm sun ease the pain of old battles. Tammra Windfield gathers Gaea seeds from Mirkfallon Lake to help the burned land grow again, and the shaman Mor'rogal senses something evil stirring beneath the mountains.

title: Stonetalon Peak
body: Stonetalon Peak crowns the northwest of the mountains, a high forested valley held sacred for ages, where ruins of a temple of Queen Azshara still stand. The night elves keep a small outpost there under Keeper Albagorm, and druids tend the woods and guard the Talon Den, their barrow, where items of power lie in hidden caches. In the Third War Jaina Proudmoore's expedition camped by the peak's caverns, and Thrall came there too, seeking the Oracle.

parts.body: The druids once hid Keeper Ordanus, one of the eldest sons of Cenarius, on the peak, and when he was hunted they spirited him away to a great tree in Ashenvale.

title: Windshear Crag
body: Windshear Crag is a broad valley in the east of the mountains where the Venture Company's greed lies bare: stumps, fouled water and a river slick with oil. Two great shredders, XT:4 and XT:9, fell trees faster than the spirits can bear, kobolds dig a strange gold-green ore from the mine at the valley's end, and from a platform above Cragpool Lake the gnome Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, his limbs half replaced by machines, watches over it all.

parts.body: Undermine's trade princes frown on the company's dealings with Gerenzo, once a head engineer of Gnomeregan whose secret project exploded in its makers' faces.

title: The Charred Vale
body: The Charred Vale in the southwest was once a verdant forest. The Venture Company set it ablaze and turned its machines upon it, loosing raging spirits of flame and stone, and even the treants who drove the goblins out came away corrupted. The Bloodfury harpies have since made it their stronghold, barring the druids who would heal it, and the road south to Desolace runs through the ash.

parts.body: Maggran Earthbinder holds the Bloodfury to be the source of the harpies spreading across Kalimdor, and wants their queen dead.
sources: quest 1844 description (once verdant, now defiled and ashen)

parts.body: Gaea seeds blessed with the Earthmother's power now grow in the ash. They resist corruption, and in time, the tauren hope, the land itself will push the harpies out.

title: Malaka'jin
body: Malaka'jin is a small troll camp at the foot of the mountains near the Barrens, whose people live well off the hunting in these hills and send recruits north to the Horde's campaign in Ashenvale. In his cave the witch doctor Jin'Zil keeps bubbling cauldrons and caged night elves, his tree-hugging friends, as he calls them.

parts.body: Jin'Zil is an old friend of Rokhan, who once went off with the mok'nathal Rexxar to slay the elder sister of Serena Bloodfeather, and he is glad to hear the last of the Bloodfeathers is dead.
